Output written and citations re-checked against the pinned files (note: `plugins/_collections.js` attrsGroups closes at :316 and globalEvent at :305, corrected).

- `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/8441.json`
- Trust decision: the opt-in `removeScripts` visitor decides executable content in its enter/exit hooks (`plugins/removeScripts.js:83-125`) via `isExecutableUrl` (`lib/svgo/tools.js:168-198`), and at the pin it has no idea SVG-namespace `foreignObject` descendants are HTML, so HTML-only `on*`, `srcdoc` and `action/data/formaction/href/src` pass through.
- `pattern_fit`: A+B — published scope includes a lower-level shared helper (`lib/svgo/tools.js`, hardened on the v3 commit) plus many input shapes and an over-broad break surface, and O8 adds two routes (tab/LF/CR-split scheme; SMIL-set `href`).
- Strongest lever: namespace-aware identity + depth state for `foreignObject`/`a` (prefixed, locally declared aliases, custom namespaces preserved) while an over-broad fix breaks inert `data:image/*` and `custom:*` content.
- Biggest red flag: `tiny_repo` (single small ESM package; 611 files total), with repo size not measurable without a shell.
